tu_vous.en: Good morning madam, how are you?
tu_vous.note: vous: a stranger, and a formal title

tu_vous.en: Hi Marie! How are you?
Excuse me sir, can you help me?
Dad, are you coming to eat?
Director, you are right.
Darling, have you seen my keys?
Hello, what would you like?
tu_vous.note: vous: shop assistant to a customer

tu_vous.en: So kids, are you ready?
tu_vous.note: vous: plural — several people, however close

tu_vous.en: Granny, do you want some tea?
Madam, your table is ready.
Marc, I'll call you tonight.
tu_vous.note: tu: a friend — object pronoun follows too

tu_vous.en: Doctor, do you think it's serious?

tu_vous.fr: Tom, {ton} vélo est dans le jardin.
tu_vous.en: Tom, your bike is in the garden.
Hello, have you booked?
tu_vous.note: vous: restaurant staff to a guest

tu_vous.en: Julie, come and see!
Ladies and gentlemen, please sit down.
My love, I miss you.

tu_vous.fr: Madame la présidente, {puis-je} vous poser une question ?
tu_vous.en: Madam President, may I ask you a question?
Hi, do you fancy a cinema trip?
tu_vous.note: tu: informal invitation to a mate

tu_vous.fr: Pardon monsieur, {savez-vous} où est la gare ?
tu_vous.en: Excuse me sir, do you know where the station is?
Léa, are your parents well?
tu_vous.note: tu: friend — plural possessive still tu-form

tu_vous.en: Hello, let me introduce my colleague.
tu_vous.note: vous: introducing in a professional setting

tu_vous.en: Grandpa, tell me a story.
Dear customer, we thank you.
Hey, what are you doing tonight?
Madam, could you wait?
tu_vous.note: vous: polite request to a customer

tu_vous.en: Paul, shall we use tu with each other?
tu_vous.note: the moment you switch register — se tutoyer

tu_vous.fr: On peut {se} tutoyer, si vous voulez.
tu_vous.en: We can use tu, if you like.
tu_vous.note: offering the switch — note the vous while still asking

tu_vous.en: Hello, are you Mr Dupont?
tu_vous.note: vous: meeting someone for the first time

tu_vous.en: Hi guys, are you coming?
tu_vous.note: vous: plural of tu — friends, but more than one

avoir_etre.en: Yesterday I ate at a restaurant.
avoir_etre.note: avoir: transitive verb with an object

avoir_etre.fr: Nous {avons} vu un très bon film.
avoir_etre.en: We saw a very good film.

avoir_etre.fr: Ils {ont} pris le train de huit heures.
avoir_etre.en: They took the eight o'clock train.

avoir_etre.note: avoir: passer with an object takes avoir

avoir_etre.fr: Elle {a} été malade la semaine dernière.
avoir_etre.note: avoir: être itself takes avoir in French
être: aller — one of the DR & MRS VANDERTRAMP verbs

avoir_etre.en: Did you go out last night?
We went up to the first floor.

avoir_etre.fr: Mon grand-père {est} mort il y a deux ans.
avoir_etre.en: My grandfather died two years ago.

avoir_etre.fr: Je me {suis} levé à six heures.
avoir_etre.note: être: reflexive verbs always take être

avoir_etre.fr: Tu t'{es} souvenu de son nom ?

avoir_etre.en: She dropped by to see you.
avoir_etre.note: être: passer WITHOUT an object takes être
avoir: monter WITH an object takes avoir
avoir: descendre WITH an object takes avoir
avoir: sortir WITH an object takes avoir
